mapper.sql: id, workflow_id, status, start_time, end_time, step_results, error_message
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.workflow_id, e.status, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.step_results, e.error_message, w.name as workflow_name FROM monitor_workflow_execution e LEFT JOIN monitor_workflow w ON e.workflow_id = w.id WHERE e.workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY e.start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id, e.workflow_id, e.status, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.step_results, e.error_message, w.name as workflow_name FROM monitor_workflow_execution e LEFT JOIN monitor_workflow w ON e.workflow_id = w.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT e.id, e.workflow_id, e.status, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.step_results, e.error_message, w.name as workflow_name FROM monitor_workflow_execution e LEFT JOIN monitor_workflow w ON e.workflow_id = w.id ORDER BY e.start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM monitor_workflow_execution WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitor_workflow_execution(workflow_id, status, start_time, end_time, step_results, error_message) VALUES(#{workflowId}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{stepResults}, #{errorMessage})
